_meta.keys: composite services S1..S4 = Key 91..94 (ML-DSA-65 seed [n]*32, Ed25519 [n+100]*32); ED Ed25519 seed [95]*32; EC P-256 scalar sha256([96]) mod 2^255; ML ML-DSA-65 seed [97]*32
_meta.spec: RFC 9942 / RFC 9162 / RFC 9943; CC 2.7.11; the rc22 head-receipt model (CC 3.2 T6)

head.description: Three services, each one receipt, each over a different holder statement of the head.
S1 has receipts over two statements of the head, S2 over one: S1 counts once.
The services list names S1 twice under two ids: one key, counted once (the first id).
S2's receipt carries no iat: nothing dates it, so it does not count.

S2's receipt is for a statement of ANOTHER head at the same place (same prev, a different payload), passed beside the head's own statements: it is not a statement of the head, so it counts for nothing (evidence of equivocation, surfaced by the caller).
S2's receipt over the other head's statement, carried in a head statement's header: its leaf is not this statement's, so it does not verify.
S2's receipt names S3 as its iss: it is not counted for S2.
S2's receipt names another subject: not the statement's own sub, not counted.
S2's receipt names no sub: refused on the head path.

mint.description: S1's receipt for LOG leaf 2 with iss S1, the statement's sub and iat 1767312000: a minter must produce these bytes.

receipts_of.description: Eighteen distinct receipts and one repeated: the held set is the first 16 in byte order, unique.
Header 394 carries one receipt and four items that are not receipts (a non-CBOR byte, an array, a tag 18 without vdp, another without vdp): the receipt is held, the rest ignored.

verify.description: A composite service's receipt over head statement A in a 7-leaf log, leaf 2.
A ed25519 service's receipt over head statement A in a 7-leaf log, leaf 2.
A p256 service's receipt over head statement A in a 7-leaf log, leaf 2.
A mldsa65 service's receipt over head statement A in a 7-leaf log, leaf 2.
A one-leaf log: the path is empty and the root is the leaf hash.
The last leaf of the 7-leaf log.
The receipt carries the root as an attached payload: it must equal the root.
The statement carries receipts in its own header: the leaf empties the unprotected header, so the receipt still verifies.
A composite receipt read under an Ed25519 key.
S1's receipt (kid S1) read under S2's key.
S1's receipt naming no kid, read under S2's key: the signature fails.
vds 2, not RFC9162_SHA256.
The proof's leaf index is the tree size.
The path lacks its last hash: it ends before the root.
A path hash with one bit flipped: another root, so the signature fails.
A receipt for head statement B read over statement A: another leaf, another root.
An Ed25519 key whose COSE_Key names alg -19, and a receipt under -19.
A receipt under -8 read with a key that names -19: the algs are not interchangeable.
A receipt naming a sub other than the statement's.
A receipt naming no sub, for a statement that names one.
The receipt is a bare CBOR array, not tag 18.
A receipt over a leaf that is not a row statement, read with verify_receipt_for_leaf.
